description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for the ChannelsSettings view, defining the UI layout and behavior for a channels configuration panel, including sidebar, detail views, and interaction logic.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main layout of the ChannelsSettings UI, including sidebar and detail views with lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view showing enabled and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Constructs the detail view for the selected channel or an empty state.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view when no channel is selected.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Builds the detailed view for a specific channel, including header and channel sections.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Creates a row in the sidebar for a given channel, handling selection state.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates a section header label within the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds the header part of the channel detail view, displaying title, status, last check, and error state.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Creates a badge displaying the channel status text with appropriate color styling.
